# Task template

New task: copy this block to `backlog/t-nnn-<slug>.md`, take the next free number from the [[backlog|Backlog]], replace the placeholders, and add a row there.

```markdown
---
title: "T-nnn — <task in one sentence>"
---
# T-nnn — <task in one sentence>

**Status:** open · **Scope:** game | template · **Depends on:** <tasks, or —>

**Read for that:** <the pages and ADRs the task needs, no more>

**What:** <what is wrong or missing, and what to build>

**Done when:** <what can be checked>
```
